description: This file defines the ServiceLocation class, which models the <service-location> XML element within the OFBiz framework's service configuration. It includes constructors and getter methods to handle service location data and throws exceptions if required attributes are missing.

classes.name: ServiceLocation
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe model class representing a service location element with name and location attributes.

methods.name: ServiceLocation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ServiceLocation object from an XML Element and a location string; throws ServiceConfigException if attributes are missing or empty.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location string for this service location.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of this service location.
